classification.difficultyReason: Find missing orthogonal side lengths using opposite-side totals and equal-length marks, then add all boundary lengths.

content.prompt: Calculate the perimeter of each of these shapes.

spec.description: Unfilled L-shape with the taller section at left.
spec.mathematics: Top 9 m, inner vertical 5 m, middle horizontal 25 m, right vertical 8 m; bottom and left side unlabelled.

answer.worked:
Bottom side: $9+25=34\text{ m}$. Left side: $5+8=13\text{ m}$.
$$\begin{aligned}P&=9+5+25+8+34+13\\P&=94\text{ m}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Orthogonal shape with a lower-right notch and four single-ticked edges.
spec.mathematics: Right short vertical, inner horizontal, inner vertical and bottom horizontal are each 7 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 7 cm and the equal-length marks appear.

answer.worked:
Each single-ticked side is $7\text{ cm}$. Top and left sides are each $7+7=14\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{aligned}P&=14+7+7+7+7+14\\P&=56\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Wide base with a raised central rectangle; two equal-length families and an unlabelled full-height arrow.
spec.mathematics: Double-ticked top and raised verticals are 6 mm; single-ticked shoulders and outer verticals are 5 mm.
spec.answerVisibility: The full-height arrow remains unlabelled; no calculated lengths appear.

answer.worked:
Single-ticked sides are $5\text{ mm}$ and double-ticked sides are $6\text{ mm}$. Bottom side: $5+6+5=16\text{ mm}$.
$$\begin{aligned}P&=16+5+5+6+6+6+5+5\\P&=54\text{ mm}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: L-shape with a top horizontal arm and descending left leg.
spec.mathematics: Top 11 mm, left 12 mm, short right 5 mm, bottom 3 mm; inner sides unlabelled.

answer.worked:
Inner horizontal side: $11-3=8\text{ mm}$. Inner vertical side: $12-5=7\text{ mm}$.
$$\begin{aligned}P&=11+5+8+7+3+12\\P&=46\text{ mm}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Tall left section and lower right extension.
spec.mathematics: Left 20 cm, bottom 15 cm, right short vertical 5 cm; the inner horizontal has a matching single tick.
spec.answerVisibility: Top and inner vertical remain unlabelled.

answer.worked:
Inner horizontal side: $5\text{ cm}$. Top side: $15-5=10\text{ cm}$. Inner vertical side: $20-5=15\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{aligned}P&=10+15+5+5+15+20\\P&=70\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: T-shape with three distinct equal-length tick families.
spec.mathematics: Top 25 cm; double-ticked outer verticals 4 cm; single-ticked shoulders 7 cm; triple-ticked stem verticals 13 cm.

answer.worked:
Matching ticks give the other outer vertical as $4\text{ cm}$, the other shoulder as $7\text{ cm}$ and the other stem vertical as $13\text{ cm}$. Bottom side: $25-7-7=11\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{aligned}P&=25+4+7+13+11+13+7+4\\P&=84\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Rectangle with a downward rectangular notch in its top boundary.
spec.mathematics: Left 20 cm; double-ticked upper horizontals 12 cm; single-ticked notch floor and both notch verticals 6 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Bottom and right outer side remain unlabelled.

answer.worked:
The other top side is $12\text{ cm}$ and both notch verticals are $6\text{ cm}$. Bottom side: $12+6+12=30\text{ cm}$. Right outer side: $20\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{aligned}P&=12+6+6+6+12+20+30+20\\P&=112\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Stepped shape, lower at left and taller at right.
spec.mathematics: Left 13 m; double-ticked right vertical and bottom horizontal 18 m; single-ticked shoulder and top horizontal equal.
spec.answerVisibility: The rise and equal horizontal lengths remain unlabelled.

answer.worked:
Bottom side: $18\text{ m}$, from the double ticks. The two single-ticked horizontal sides are equal, so each is $18\div2=9\text{ m}$. Vertical rise: $18-13=5\text{ m}$.
$$\begin{aligned}P&=13+9+5+9+18+18\\P&=72\text{ m}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Three descending horizontal levels, with the 12 m label rotated beside the first descent.
spec.mathematics: Top 6 m; first descent 12 m; middle horizontal 16 m; lower horizontal 10 m. Single ticks identify both remaining descents as 6 m.
spec.answerVisibility: Full left side and bottom side remain unlabelled.

answer.worked:
Both short vertical sides are $6\text{ m}$, from the matching ticks. Bottom side: $6+16+10=32\text{ m}$. Left side: $12+6+6=24\text{ m}$.
$$\begin{aligned}P&=6+12+16+6+10+6+32+24\\P&=112\text{ m}\end{aligned}$$
